method: Started from 2,392 priced Kalshi legs in the next 36h. Kept legs priced 30–85¢ with edge ≥ −2.5 and no flags, one per game, and checked them against today's 125 newly collected expert picks plus injury news. Polymarket top-trader data came back empty today, so every leg needed both a published pick or model on its side and concrete news or matchup reasoning, with no published pick against it. Dropped for conflicts: Ravens spread (SI's MacMillan has the Chargers moneyline as his best bet, so the ladder uses the Under, which no one opposes); Canadiens/Rangers (experts split 2–2 on the side, and Dimers and Lineups split on the total); Canucks/Mammoth (Covers has Vancouver); Rockets/Heat, Blazers/Timberwolves, Warriors/Pelicans and Suns/Nuggets (Covers' Metler on the opposite side to Dimers, SI or BetMGM). Excluded on price or flags: Grizzlies moneyline (line moved 7 points against), 76ers moneyline, Spurs moneyline, Tulsa and Drake (edges worse than −2.5). Tuesday NHL and most Tuesday NBA games had no published previews yet, so the ladder runs Monday night, then Tuesday MACtion.
honest: Every leg costs slightly more than its fair price (edge −1.1 to −2.5¢ each), so expected return is slightly negative, and it gets worse with each leg you add.

ladder.label: Under 38.5
ladder.why: Covers' Jason Logan and Dimers' Ryan Leaver (model 54.3%, projects 20-15) both take Under 38.5, and no published pick takes the Over. Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley are out, so Jacoby Brissett makes his first Ravens start, and Justin Herbert has a hand injury; the Chargers are 6-2 to the Under this season.

ladder.label: Under 245.5
ladder.why: Dimers' Mac Douglass (his strongest model edge of the slate, under 241.5) and SI (under 242.5) both lean Under, so this leg buys four extra points of cushion. Evan Mobley is out for Cleveland and SI notes the Bulls rank 26th in offensive rating.

ladder.label: Memphis Grizzlies +2.5
ladder.why: SI's Peter Dewey, Dimers' Mac Douglass and Covers' Jon Metler all have Memphis to win outright; this leg only needs Washington not to win by 3+. The Wizards have lost 7 straight and are on the second night of a back-to-back. Caveat: Ty Jerome was ruled out after Metler wrote his pick, and the Grizzlies moneyline has drifted.

ladder.label: Boston Celtics
ladder.why: Covers' Jon Metler (Celtics ML) and the BetMGM model (Celtics −8.5, 68.4% cover confidence) both back Boston, and no outlet picks Orlando to win. Paolo Banchero (high ankle sprain) is out for the Magic, along with Isaac, Nelson and Penda. Caveat: Boston is on the second night of a back-to-back.

ladder.label: Philadelphia 76ers +3.5
ladder.why: Three outlets have the 76ers winning outright: Covers' Jon Metler, SI's Peter Dewey (as a parlay leg) and the Dimers Data model (68.8%); this leg only needs Brooklyn not to win by 4+. Joel Embiid is expected back, and Michael Porter Jr. is out for the Nets. Caveat: LeBron James is likely out on the back-to-back.

ladder.game: Miami (OH) RedHawks @ Kent State Golden Flashes
ladder.label: Miami (OH) RedHawks
ladder.why: All three published picks back Miami: numberFire's model (75.9%), Bang The Book (moneyline) and iHeart's algorithm (projects 31-19). Kent State scores 15.7 points per game (136th), and VSiN's Adam Burke rates the game Miami −12, above the market's −7.5 to −9.5.
